Put your walkthrough on your website

Copy the walkthrough’s embed code, then paste it into a custom HTML block on your page. Here is where that block is in each builder.

WordPress
In the block editor, add a Custom HTML block, paste the embed code, then Preview and Update. Some page-builder and security plugins strip embeds for non-administrators; ask your site administrator if it disappears.
Squarespace
Add a Code block (not a Markdown block), paste the embed code, keep "Display source" off and save. Code blocks need a Business or Commerce plan.
Wix
Add Embed, then Embed HTML, choose Code, paste the embed code and apply. Make the element at least 320 pixels tall, or the button that starts the walkthrough is cut off.
Webflow
Drag an Embed element into the page, paste the embed code and publish. Embeds show only on the published site, not in the designer.

Any other builder: ask for a custom HTML or raw HTML area and paste the code there. Give it at least 320 pixels of height.

If it doesn’t work

Blank or cut off? Check the element is at least 320 pixels tall, and check the published page on a phone.

Shows "not available"? Sharing is paused or turned off for that walkthrough.

Listing portals do not accept the embed code. Use the listing URL: see share your walkthrough.

Still stuck? Email Veylet support

Write to yoda@yodalai.xyz and a person replies. Say which step you were on, your iPhone or iPad model, and the app version from Account, then About. Never send passwords or sign-in links.
